title: Sahasra Semiconductors Inaugurates India's 1st SME ATMP Chip Packaging Facility in Bhiwadi
summary: MeitY Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw inaugurates ₹150 Cr SPECS-supported semiconductor packaging plant in Rajasthan.

blocks.title: 📰 5. 🤝 MoUs, CONFERENCES & APPOINTMENTS
blocks.text: 🪝 Sahasra Semiconductors Inaugurates India's 1st SME ATMP Chip Packaging Facility in Bhiwadi. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw virtually inaugurated Sahasra Semiconductors' ₹150 Cr ATMP/OSAT chip packaging plant in Bhiwadi, Rajasthan under MeitY's SPECS scheme.
